# `deprecated-removed`

Deprecation withdrawn

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `deprecated-removed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M6) |
| **Group** | Lifecycle and versions ([RULES.md section 9](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A deprecation was withdrawn.

## Why this default

Nothing breaks.

## Example

From test case [`deprecated-removed`](../../test/cases/deprecated-removed/): Deprecation withdrawn from an operation and a query parameter: info.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
          - name: limit
            in: query
-           deprecated: true
            schema:
              type: integer
  …
      get:
        operationId: getPet
-       deprecated: true
        responses:
          '200':
```

Findings:

- `deprecated-removed` · info · GET /pets
- `deprecated-removed` · info · GET /pets/{id}

## Test cases

The example above is the only test case for this rule.


## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. See [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  deprecated-removed: info
```
